objective: Definir el contrato puro de beneficios y reglas comerciales de membresia para Cavas, separando producto PERSONAL de CORPORATIVA. Debe soportar beneficios configurables por unidad/contrato para ALIMENTOS, BEBIDAS o AMBOS; ventanas horarias, dias permitidos/restringidos, fecha de vigencia, elegibilidad de negocio, usuarios registrados, limites opcionales de personas y restricciones configurables. No hardcodear horarios como 14:00-20:00 ni limite 22:00; deben ser datos de politica. No crear DDL ni logica POS especifica.

actions.content:
import pytest

from modules.cava_socios.domain import (
    BenefitLine,
    BenefitTimeWindow,
    CavaProductKind,
    MembershipBenefitPolicy,
    benefit_applies_to_line,
    validate_membership_benefit_policy,
)


def _policy(**overrides):
    data = dict(
        policy_id="POL-1",
        product_kind=CavaProductKind.CORPORATIVA,
        benefit_line=BenefitLine.AMBOS,
        valid_from="2026-01-01",
        valid_to=None,
        allowed_weekdays=(1, 2, 3, 4, 5),
        time_windows=(BenefitTimeWindow("14:00", "20:00", "22:00"),),
        registered_users_required=True,
        business_purpose_required=True,
        max_people=None,
    )
    data.update(overrides)
    return MembershipBenefitPolicy(**data)


def test_corporate_policy_requires_registered_users_and_business_purpose():
    validate_membership_benefit_policy(_policy())
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_membership_benefit_policy(_policy(registered_users_required=False))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_membership_benefit_policy(_policy(business_purpose_required=False))


def test_hours_are_policy_data_not_domain_constants():
    validate_membership_benefit_policy(_policy(time_windows=(BenefitTimeWindow("12:00", "18:30", "21:00"),)))
    validate_membership_benefit_policy(_policy(time_windows=(BenefitTimeWindow("16:00", "21:00", "23:00"),)))


def test_people_limit_is_optional():
    validate_membership_benefit_policy(_policy(max_people=None))
    validate_membership_benefit_policy(_policy(max_people=12))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_membership_benefit_policy(_policy(max_people=0))


def test_benefit_line_can_be_food_beverage_or_both():
    both = _policy(benefit_line=BenefitLine.AMBOS)
    assert benefit_applies_to_line(both, BenefitLine.ALIMENTOS) is True
    assert benefit_applies_to_line(both, BenefitLine.BEBIDAS) is True
    food = _policy(benefit_line=BenefitLine.ALIMENTOS)
    assert benefit_applies_to_line(food, BenefitLine.ALIMENTOS) is True
    assert benefit_applies_to_line(food, BenefitLine.BEBIDAS) is False


def test_personal_and_corporate_are_distinct_products():
    assert CavaProductKind.PERSONAL != CavaProductKind.CORPORATIVA


def test_weekday_and_restriction_policy_is_configurable():
    validate_membership_benefit_policy(_policy(allowed_weekdays=(2, 3, 4), restriction_codes=("NO_FESTIVOS", "NO_EVENTOS_ESPECIALES")))

constraints: Personal and corporate Cavas are distinct products sharing domain primitives
Benefit line must be configurable as food, beverages or both
Registered-user and business-purpose requirements belong to corporate policy
People limits and day restrictions are configurable, not universal
